label: NETGEAR Nighthawk CM2050V 2.5 Gbps DOCSIS 3.1 cable telephony modem
description: DOCSIS 3.1 cable modem with 32x8 SC-QAM plus 2 OFDM and 2 OFDMA channels, exposing a single 2.5GBASE-T port; the two RJ11 telephone jacks are FXS voice lines, not data ports.
notes: Datasheet technical specifications: '32x8 SC-QAM + 2 OFDM & 2 OFDMA', '1 x 2.5G Ethernet Port', 'Two Telephone Ports' that prioritize voice (FXS - deliberately excluded from interfaces, a phone jack is not a data port). One wired data port only, so no bridging decisions to make.
